title: Peaks of Asia (guided)
intro: 10 peaks of Asia, one after another. Put your marker as near as you can; the nearer, the more points. The map shows coasts, rivers, lakes and borders to help you.

rounds.name: Mount Yonaha
rounds.fact: Mount Yonaha has a recorded summit elevation of 498 m in the source data. The data places it in Japan.
